name: Processor B
topology: Participant-designed sparse interaction-aware graph (12 undirected edges)
design_rationale: The six-node Max-Cut instance is symmetry-reduced by fixing graph node 0, leaving five logical qubits. The six pairwise interactions among those five logical variables are mapped onto the six edges in physical nodes 0-4. Four extra physical qubits and six sparse extension edges bring the model to nine qubits and twelve edges. This is a participant-designed connectivity choice, not a mandated topology; the report should discuss that it is tailored to this fixed instance.
